fact: The 2024-2026 Partnership Compact commits a GPE Systems Capacity Grant of $1.6 million to, among other things, support the Ministry of Education and Training as it moves from OpenEMIS to DHIS2 and a pooled-funding mechanism chiefly for EMIS and learning assessments; it says the EMIS bulletin was last published for 2020, delayed by lack of financing and of capacity for OpenEMIS, and that individual child dashboards are only to be explored, with secondary schools.
title: Education Partnership Compact: Enhancing the Quality of Teaching and Learning for Improved Learning Attainment at Basic Education, 2024-2026
publisher: Kingdom of Lesotho, Ministry of Education and Training
